name: – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean MON 94313 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of food and feed made from a genetically modified soybean called MON 94313. The soybean is engineered to survive spraying with four weedkillers, including glufosinate, which is banned in the European Union. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete and that approving the soybean would harm biodiversity, farmers and public trust. This is Parliament's opinion; the final decision rests with the Commission.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw its plan and not authorise the soybean.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed importers, consumers and the environment, mainly in countries growing the soybean.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its plan; Parliament also wants new rules on how such decisions are made.
